description: Scans a repository for versioned database migration files (Flyway V*.sql, Prisma migration.sql, Liquibase XML/YAML) and classifies each operation as additive (rollback safe) or destructive (forward-fix only). Returns rollback_eligible, a list of blocking_migrations with file and line, and deployment_strategy. Use before recommending deployment to determine whether a rollback is safe after go-live.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the repository root to scan for migration files

name: analyze_rollback_readiness
